we propose Fusion by Synthesis which is a novel multi view neural network for zero-shot learning, which leverages word embedding of classes as complementary to attributes, and performs zero shot recognition by fusing the synthesized attributes with the word embeddings of classes in the visual feature.
we introduce a multi view deep neural model, which is capable of synthesizing attributes from visual feature space and word embedding space for zero shot recognition.

(1) we introduce a new multi view deep learning framework to fuse multi views by synthesis, which is flexible to learn and predict with partial view information; (2) we propose a new ZSL framework, Fusion by Synthesis, which is capable of synthesizing missing views and achieves the best performance on six benchmark datasets.

the following questions.

our proposed FS method achieves the best performance among existing ZSL methods on six benchmark datasets.
FS achieves state of the art performance on both zero shot image classification and action classification.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
FS is a novel multi view learning method for zero shot recognition by fusing multi view data by synthesizing.
FS is the first deep neural network for ZSL by synthesizing multi views of data.

We proposed a multi view deep neural framework to fuse multi view information (visual feature, attribute and word embedding) by synthesis, which is flexible to learn and synthesize with partial view data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed multi view deep neural architecture, termed Fusion by synthesis, is capable of fusing multi view data by synthesizing and can be easily extended to learn with partial view data.
fusing multi views by synthesis can effectively improve zero shot recognition.
fusing multi view data by synthesizing is a promising way to improve the zero shot recognition.
